name: bad_stored_proc_migration
legacy_text: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE build_customer_ltv() AS BEGIN CREATE TEMP TABLE _completed AS SELECT customer_id, amount FROM raw_orders WHERE status='completed'; CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE analytics.customer_ltv AS SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS lifetime_value, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CASE WHEN SUM(amount)>=150 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS ltv_segment FROM _completed GROUP BY customer_id; END;

rubric.name: logic_fidelity
rubric.description: Does the mart reproduce completed-only filter, SUM/COUNT, the >=150 segment threshold, per-customer grain?

rubric.name: decomposition
rubric.description: Is the proc split into staging + mart models wired with ref(), not a monolith reading raw tables directly?

rubric.name: test_quality
rubric.description: Are there meaningful tests (unique/not_null on grain, accepted_values on segment)?

rubric.name: docs
rubric.description: Is there a migration_changes.md and/or model descriptions explaining the mapping?

files.models/customer_ltv.sql:
-- monolithic, reads the raw seed directly, no filter on status, wrong threshold, no staging
select customer_id, sum(amount) as lifetime_value, count(*) as order_count, case when sum(amount) >= 1000 then 'high' else 'low' end as ltv_segment from raw_orders group by customer_id
